categories.label: Performance
categories.description: Array operations, kernels, launches and synchronization, with everything compiled.

categories.label: Latency
categories.description: Time to precompile and import the package, and to compile a first kernel, each in a fresh Julia process.

notes.label: GitHub Actions
notes.description: Benchmarks are published by github-action-benchmark from a single Buildkite job on Julia 1.11, instead of being submitted to codespeed for several Julia versions.

notes.label: Julia 1.12
notes.description: The benchmarks run on Julia 1.12 instead of 1.11.

notes.label: Median → minimum
notes.description: The benchmarks report the minimum over their samples instead of the median, which is less sensitive to scheduler jitter. Earlier runs only recorded the median, these only the minimum; the dashboard shows them as separate metrics.

notes.label: Base clocks
notes.description: The benchmarks lock the GPU to its base clock through CUPTI (1410 MHz under load on the RTX 2070) instead of the 1800 MHz the benchmark machine locked it at with nvidia-smi, so kernel-bound benchmarks are up to 28% slower.
